author: Henry Ketcham
claims: The manuscript of the inaugural address was lost by Lincoln's son, Robert.
Lincoln was very annoyed and angry about the loss of the manuscript.
The loss of the manuscript was a concern because premature publication could cause mischief, and Lincoln had no duplicate copy.
The lost satchel containing the address was found in the baggage room of a hotel.
The found satchel contained a bottle of whisky.
The second inaugural address was read during Lincoln's funeral services in Springfield.
Lincoln's second inaugural address was delivered on a rainy morning in February, 1861, when he left Springfield.
